props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the formula after every edit.

props.name: functions
props.description: Functions offered and understood. Defaults to SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX, COUNT, ROUND, ABS, IF and CONCAT.

props.name: cells
props.description: Cell values by reference (`A1`). When given, the result is computed and shown.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name. Pair with a Field for a visible one.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid from outside. Parse errors do this by themselves once the field is left.

props.name: id
props.description: Overrides the generated id. Field supplies one.

props.name: 'aria-describedby'
props.description: Extra descriptions, such as a Field hint.
